items.example: My workload is crazy this month.
items.simple: All the jobs you must do at work.

items.example: She got promoted after only a year.
items.exampleTr: Sadece bir yıl sonra terfi etti.
items.simple: Your boss gives you a better job with more money.

items.en: I'm up to my eyes in work
items.tr: Başımı kaşıyacak vaktim yok, işe gömüldüm
items.example: I'm up to my eyes in work this week.
items.simple: You have so much to do that you can hardly breathe.

items.example: It's late, let's call it a day.
items.simple: You stop working now and go home.

items.example: The manager stepped down last month.
items.simple: A boss leaves their big job so someone else can take it.

items.example: I asked my boss for a raise.
items.simple: Your boss gives you more money for the same job.

items.example: I've got a job interview tomorrow.
items.simple: A talk where people ask you questions to see if you can get a job.

items.example: I had to work overtime all week.
items.exampleTr: Bütün hafta fazla mesai yapmak zorunda kaldım.
items.simple: You work more hours than normal.

items.example: Too much work can lead to burnout.
items.simple: You worked so hard for so long that you have no energy left at all.

items.example: Sorry, I'm swamped at the moment.
items.exampleTr: Üzgünüm, şu an başımdan aşkın işim var.
items.simple: You have far too much to do right now.

items.example: I don't want to take on any more work.
items.simple: You say yes to a job or to a new task.

items.example: They laid off fifty people last year.
items.exampleTr: Geçen yıl elli kişiyi işten çıkardılar.
items.simple: A company tells workers they must go because there is not enough money.

items.example: He works freelance from home.
items.simple: You work for yourself and not for one big company.

items.example: She's climbing the career ladder fast.
items.simple: You get better and better jobs, one step at a time.

items.example: You learn a lot on the job.
items.simple: While you are really doing the work.

items.example: I'll get back to you by Monday.
items.simple: You will answer later, after you check.

items.en: I'm between jobs at the moment.
items.example: I'm between jobs at the moment, so I'm free.
items.exampleTr: Şu an iş arıyorum, o yüzden müsaitim.
items.simple: You do not have a job now, but you want a new one.

items.example: She's really well qualified for the job.
items.simple: You have learned the right things to do a job well.

items.example: He resigned after the argument.
items.simple: You tell your boss you are leaving your job for good.

items.example: I'm on the night shift this week.
items.simple: The set hours when you work, like day or night.

items.example: I'm fully booked until next week.
items.simple: Every hour is already taken, so nothing more can fit.

items.example: They promoted her to manager.
items.simple: The boss gives someone a bigger, better job.
